title: THE OVERSEER REDRAWN
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sprites of all characters and machines. The boss was a Warden drawn at 147 percent and nothing about it said boss. now: THE OVERSEER is redrawn: black and brass, twin cannons, a crown of sensor masts and one big red eye.
